rules.headings: Playfair Display for massive YES/NO answers and massive emotional impact.
rules.body: Outfit (or Manrope) for UI elements, labels, buttons, and source descriptions.

sizes.hero_answer: text-8xl sm:text-[12vw] font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-black

colors.rules: No gradients. No purple AI aesthetics. Pure monochromatic grayscale for a premium, editorial, print-like aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.texture: Global fixed overlay with white paper grain to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Extremely soft and diffuse. shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] for cards and dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E5E5 for separation. Input gets 2px black border on focus.
visual_enhancers.corners: Soft rounded corners (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl) to blend SaaS simplicity with editorial type.

layouts.container: max-w-3xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12 py-12 min-h-[100svh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative z-10
layouts.alignment: Center-aligned main container, but left-aligned inner content for sections like 'Reasoning' and 'Sources' to maintain reading rhythm.

components.Header: Absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 p-6 flex justify-between items-center. Contains 'yesno' logo (Playfair).
components.SearchBar: Massive, dominant. Use a giant input element, text-2xl md:text-4xl, rounded-2xl, border-2 border-transparent bg-gray-50 focus:bg-white focus:border-black transition-colors px-6 py-4 md:py-6 w-full. Submit arrow inside right.
components.AnswerDisplay: Massive Playfair Display text (YES/NO). For probabilistic: Horizontal stacked bar or side-by-side bars. YES bar in black, NO bar in gray. Include 'YES 72%' labels.
components.ReasonButton: Secondary button below answer. rounded-full border border-gray-200 hover:border-black bg-white px-6 py-2 text-sm transition-all flex items-center gap-2.
components.ReasonPanel: Expands smoothly (Framer Motion height animation). Contains 'WHY?' (short paragraph), 'EVIDENCE' (bullet points), 'SOURCES' (stacked horizontal cards).
components.SourceCard: Stacked layout. bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow. Title text-black, publisher text-xs text-gray-500.
components.History_Examples: Below search bar before search. 'Try asking:' pill-shaped buttons with example questions. History clearly labeled with a 'Clear' action.

motion.rules: Fast, crisp. Search input compresses (moves up, reduces padding). Answer scales up from 0.95 and fades in. Probability bars animate width from 0% to final.
motion.loading: Elegant text-based 'yesno is thinking...' with subtle opacity pulse. NO standard spinners.

background_texture.description: White paper grain texture. Use as fixed inset-0 z-0 pointer-events-none opacity-[0.25] mix-blend-multiply.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind with Outfit and Playfair Display fonts.
Build a single-page app structure. The default state is centered search. Upon Enter, animate the search bar upwards and fade in the Answer component.
Ensure the probability bar fills up dynamically from 0 to its value using Framer Motion.
Sources should stack vertically as distinct cards on mobile, grid or vertical stack on desktop.
Implement local storage for recent searches.
All components must be accessible (focus states, ARIA labels, semantic HTML).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth through layered design elements, typography hierarchy, and strategic whitespace.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
